datasets.name: 8673aa08
queryLines:
SELECT
    SUBSTR(h.forecast_time, 12, 8) AS forecast_time,
    l.city,
    l.country,
    CAST(h.forecast_time AS DATE) AS forecast_date,
    ROUND(h.temperature_c, 1) AS temperature_c
FROM weather_forcast.gold.fact_hourly_weather h
JOIN weather_forcast.gold.dim_location l
    ON h.location_id = l.location_id
ORDER BY h.forecast_time;

datasets.name: 1c6c92c7
datasets.displayName: Global City Daily Average Temperature Summary
queryLines:
SELECT
    l.country,
    l.city,
    CAST(h.forecast_time AS DATE) AS forecast_date,
    ROUND(AVG(h.temperature_c), 1) AS avg_temperature_c
FROM weather_forcast.gold.fact_hourly_weather h
JOIN weather_forcast.gold.dim_location l
    ON h.location_id = l.location_id
GROUP BY
    l.country,
    l.city,
    CAST(h.forecast_time AS DATE)
ORDER BY
    forecast_date,
    l.country,
    l.city;

datasets.name: b67ba5e7
datasets.displayName: Global Daily City Humidity Averages Dataset
queryLines:

    l.country,

    CAST(h.forecast_time AS DATE) AS forecast_date,

datasets.name: a0198fb1
queryLines:
SELECT
  f.forecast_date,
  f.day_name,
  f.is_weekend,
  f.max_temp_c,
  f.min_temp_c,
  f.rainfall_mm as weekly_Rainfall,
  f.uv_index,
  date_format(f.sunrise, 'HH:mm') AS sunrise_time,

  f.sunshine_hours,
  f.wind_max_kmh,
  f.city,
  f.country
FROM
  gold.fact_daily_weather f
    JOIN gold.dim_location d
      ON f.location_id = d.location_id
ORDER BY
  forecast_date;
